left.raw_text:
Inclusion Criteria:
Men  [OR] and women aged 20 to 80
  -  MDD diagnosis objected to MRI (grade II/III)
  -  Joint pain for more than 3 month
  -  Absence of bone lesion  [OR] or moderate knee osteoarthritis stage <2 on the Kellgren Laurence scale (objectified on radiography in schuss) in the 6 months prior to inclusion
  -  Axial deformity of the lower limbs less than or equal to 5 °
  -  Signed consent signed by the patient
  -  Ability to perform procedures as part of the follow-up (walk 50 steps on a flat surface  [OR] and up  [OR] / down stairs)

right.raw_text:
-  Be affiliated to a health insurance scheme
Exclusion Criteria:
  -  Axial deformity> 5 °
  -  Ligament instability
  -  Major injuries  [OR] or surgery of the target knee  [OR] or lateral contralateral knee in the 12 months preceding the inclusion visit
  -  Ligament reconstruction in the 12 months prior to the inclusion visit
  -  Need a cane  [OR] or assistance to move
  -  BMI> 35
  -  Thrombocytopenia <150 G / L
  -  Thrombocytosis> 450 G / L
